editorial.marketOverview: Nasdaq/QQQ remains in a bearish elevated-downside-risk state following Thursday's broad US cash selloff, negative semiconductor leadership, weak breadth and elevated VIX. Friday US regular trading has not opened; the most recent verified US session remains November 19.
editorial.whatChanged: Since the prior 00:33 EST assessment, Reuters' Friday oil report adds Brent near $92.77 and December WTI near $83.46, modestly firmer on renewed Middle East supply-disruption concerns. Asian chip weakness continues, but this does not establish a new market regime or confirmed US price reaction. The curated Open Watch file remains at 171 events.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Global AI risk aversion continues to pressure semiconductor-heavy equities. Modestly rising crude on supply fears is an additional inflation-sensitive risk to monitor, not a confirmed Fed repricing or a demonstrated cause of Nasdaq selling. The 10Y/2Y curve cannot be refreshed from non-synchronized observations; 25.4 basis points is an older indicative spread.
editorial.threeDayPath: Friday November 20 remains vulnerable to volatile downside or a failed oversold bounce, with Michigan sentiment at 10:00 EST a potential catalyst whose realized outcome and market reaction are unknown. Monday November 23 tests whether Friday stabilizes or extends Thursday's breadth and chip weakness. Tuesday November 24 offers follow-through and earnings-related reassessment.
editorial.bullCase: An oversold recovery could emerge if QQQ outperforms SPY, SOX/SMH regain leadership, breadth broadens and VXN/VIX retreat; none of these conditions is yet verified for Friday. Anthropic's positive IPO close is an isolated constructive sign.
editorial.bearCase: Broad November 19 declines, high VIX, semiconductor weakness and continued Asian technology selling support downside continuation. A Friday rally that fails amid weak breadth and chips would strengthen the bearish path into Monday. Oil-related supply concerns could add pressure if they translate into higher yields, not yet verified.
editorial.watchNext: Confirm Michigan sentiment and inflation expectations at 10:00 EST, then compare actual synchronized Friday QQQ/SPY, SOX/SMH, breadth and VXN/VIX; obtain official contemporaneous 10Y/2Y yields and Fed pricing, matched oil contracts and newly curated Open Watch events. Separate event surprises from observed US market reactions.
